title: Add SDK publishing workflow for pub.dev
description: Create GitHub Actions workflow to automatically publish the Dart SDK package to pub.dev when a release is created. This should include proper versioning and changelog generation.

title: Add AssetOrArchive union type for properties that accept either
description: Some Pulumi resources have properties that can accept either an Asset or an Archive. We should add an AssetOrArchive type (or perhaps a union type pattern) that allows callers to pass either type. The code generator should be updated to use this when the schema indicates either type is accepted.

title: Implement Runtime singleton with gRPC connections
description: Implement the Runtime singleton in sdk/dart/lib/src/runtime/runtime.dart. Must: initialize gRPC connections to monitor and engine addresses, provide access to ResourceMonitor and Engine clients, handle shutdown and cleanup, store runtime settings (project, stack, config, etc.). The Runtime.initialize() method is called by the executor with addresses from CLI args.

title: Create example Pulumi Dart projects
description: Create example projects demonstrating Pulumi Dart usage: examples/aws-s3-website/ (static website on S3), examples/aws-ec2/ (EC2 instance), examples/kubernetes-deployment/ (K8s deployment). Each example should be a complete, working Pulumi project that users can reference. Include README with instructions.

title: Add integration test for generated resource code
description: Create an integration test that: 1) Uses the code generator to generate a resource from a test schema 2) Verifies the generated Dart code compiles 3) Tests that the generated resource can register with the mock runtime. This would help catch code generation bugs early.

title: Implement GenerateProgram for PCL to Dart conversion
description: Implement the GenerateProgram function in codegen.go to convert Pulumi Configuration Language (PCL) to Dart code. This is needed for 'pulumi convert --language dart' functionality.

title: Implement ResourceMonitor gRPC client
description: Implement the ResourceMonitor gRPC client in sdk/dart/lib/src/runtime/monitor.dart. Must implement client methods for: RegisterResource, RegisterResourceOutputs, ReadResource, Invoke, Call, SupportsFeature. Use the generated proto code from TH-u2kgmx. This client is used by the Resource class to communicate with the Pulumi deployment engine.

title: Set up GitHub releases for language host distribution
description: Set up GitHub Actions workflow to build and release pulumi-language-dart binary. Cross-compile for: linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin-amd64, darwin-arm64, windows-amd64. Create release artifacts as tar.gz with proper naming convention. Configure pluginDownloadURL for automatic installation: github://api.github.com/<org>/pulumi-dart

title: Support secret outputs via ctx.exportSecret
description: Stack outputs can be marked as secrets in other Pulumi SDKs. Currently the Dart SDK only supports plain exports via ctx.export(). Add support for ctx.exportSecret() that marks outputs as secrets, and ensure the serialization properly handles the secret flag when calling RegisterResourceOutputs.

title: Add tests for gen_function.go function generation
description: Add comprehensive unit tests for generateFunction, generateFunctionArgs, and generateFunctionResult functions in gen_function.go to cover: async function wrapper generation, function argument types, function result types, documentation generation. Target is at least 80% coverage for this file.

title: Document Pulumi SDK upgrade to v3.163.0
description: The Pulumi SDK dependencies in go.mod were updated from v3.98.0 to v3.163.0 to fix schema binding issues with provider-level methods. The newer version includes proper handling for tokens like pulumi:providers:xxx/yyy. This change also required implementing new interface methods: Handshake, GetRequiredPackages, and RuntimeOptionsPrompts. Document these changes in the README or changelog.

title: Implement Engine gRPC client for logging
description: Implement the Engine gRPC client in sdk/dart/lib/src/runtime/engine.dart. This client connects to the Pulumi engine's logging service. Implement methods for Log (info, warning, error levels), GetRootResource. Use the generated proto code from TH-u2kgmx.

title: Implement CustomResource and ComponentResource classes
description: Implement CustomResource and ComponentResource as specified in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md Section 4.3.1. CustomResource: extends Resource, adds late Output<String> id, overrides _processOutputs to extract id from response. ComponentResource: extends Resource, returns empty inputs map, implements registerOutputs() method to call ResourceMonitor.registerResourceOutputs.

title: Add tests for language.proto Dart types
description: The language.proto Dart code was generated but has no tests to verify the generated types work correctly. Add unit tests that verify: 1) Message classes can be serialized/deserialized, 2) gRPC client methods have correct signatures, 3) LanguageRuntimeServiceBase abstract methods match expected interface. This ensures proto changes don't silently break the SDK.

title: Create SDK unit tests for Output, Input, and serialization
description: Create unit tests in sdk/dart/test/ for: Output<T> - test apply(), all(), asSecret(), dependency tracking, isKnown handling; Input<T> - test all sealed class variants, toOutput() conversions; PropertySerializer - test roundtrip serialization for all types. Use package:test. These tests validate the core SDK primitives.

title: Add language.proto for language host
description: The language host needs to implement the LanguageRuntime gRPC service. Download and generate Dart code from language.proto to support both the SDK and language host development.

title: Add invoke tests for dependency tracking
description: Add tests to verify that invoke properly propagates and merges dependencies from input Outputs to the result Output. This ensures proper resource ordering when using invoke results as inputs to resources.

title: Implement Output<T> class with dependency tracking
description: Implement the Output<T> class as specified in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md Section 4.3.1. Must support: creating from known values (Output.of), creating from futures (Output.fromFuture), unknown outputs, apply() for transformations while preserving dependencies, all() for combining multiple outputs, asSecret() for marking secrets, and proper isKnown/isSecret tracking. This is a core primitive that all resource handling depends on.

title: Add cross-platform build scripts for language host
description: Create build scripts to cross-compile the pulumi-language-dart binary for all supported platforms: linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin-amd64, darwin-arm64, windows-amd64. Set up GitHub Actions workflow to build and create releases. Add Makefile or build.sh script for local development.

title: Test Asset/Archive types with real provider (e.g., AWS Lambda)
description: The Asset and Archive types have been implemented with unit tests. We should verify they work correctly end-to-end with a real provider that uses these types, such as AWS Lambda (which uses Archive for code), or Azure Functions. This would validate that the serialization format matches what the Pulumi engine expects.

title: Implement GetRequiredPlugins (parse pubspec.yaml)
description: Implement GetRequiredPlugins in the language host. Must: parse pubspec.yaml to find dependencies, identify Pulumi provider packages (pulumi_aws -> aws plugin), map package versions to plugin versions, return list of required plugins. Similar to how Python SDK parses pip packages.

title: Support secret outputs via ctx.exportSecret
description: Stack outputs can be marked as secrets in other Pulumi SDKs. Currently the Dart SDK only supports plain exports via ctx.export(). Add support for ctx.exportSecret() that marks outputs as secrets, and ensure the serialization properly handles the secret flag when calling RegisterResourceOutputs.

title: Implement provider-level method generation (terraformConfig)
description: Provider-level methods like terraformConfig (tokens like pulumi:providers:xxx/yyy) are currently skipped during code generation. These are special methods that reference provider types and need special handling. The method should be generated as an instance method on the Provider class.

title: Create Go language host project structure
description: Create the Go module at cmd/pulumi-language-dart/. Set up go.mod with dependencies on Pulumi SDK. Create main.go as entry point with plugin registration. Create initial file structure: language.go, executor.go, dependencies.go, codegen.go. This is the foundation for the language host binary.

title: Test SDK generation with real pulumi-random schema
description: Download the actual pulumi-random schema and verify the generated Dart SDK compiles successfully. Test dart analyze on the generated code to ensure it passes static analysis.

title: Integrate Engine client into Runtime singleton
description: The Runtime singleton currently only holds the ResourceMonitor client. It should also hold an Engine client instance for centralized access to logging and root resource management. Update Runtime.initialize() to optionally accept an engineAddress parameter, and expose the Engine client as runtime.engine. This allows logging from anywhere in the SDK without passing the engine client around.

title: Add CI/CD pipeline for integration tests
description: Set up GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD to automatically run integration tests on PRs. Should run both Dart integration tests (tests/integration) and Go integration tests (cmd/pulumi-language-dart with -tags=integration).

title: Wire new ResourceOptions fields to resource registration
description: The new ResourceOptions fields (aliases, ignoreChanges, replaceOnChanges, customTimeouts, version, pluginDownloadUrl) and CustomResourceOptions fields (importId, deleteBeforeReplace, additionalSecretOutputs) have been added to the SDK but need integration tests to verify they're correctly sent via gRPC to the ResourceMonitor. Add integration tests in resource_integration_test.dart that verify the gRPC requests contain these fields when specified.

title: Implement Engine gRPC client for logging
description: Implement the Engine gRPC client in sdk/dart/lib/src/runtime/engine.dart. The Engine service provides logging capabilities (log, debug, info, warn, error) for the Pulumi program. Use the generated proto code from engine.pbgrpc.dart. This client is used by the Runtime singleton to send log messages to the Pulumi CLI.

title: Add fromValue factory to generated enums
description: Resource class generation now assumes enums have a fromValue factory constructor for deserializing output properties. Verify that gen_enum.go generates this factory constructor, or add it if missing. The factory should accept a string/int/double (depending on enum element type) and return the matching enum value.

title: Add resource reference serialization support
description: Extend PropertySerializer to serialize resource references. When a resource is passed as an input to another resource, it should be serialized with the resource signature including URN and ID. This enables proper resource-to-resource dependencies in the Pulumi engine.

title: Add cloud-specific Dart templates (aws-dart, kubernetes-dart)
description: Create cloud-specific templates in templates/ directory for AWS (templates/aws-dart/) and Kubernetes (templates/kubernetes-dart/). These templates should include example resource creation code and proper provider dependencies in pubspec.yaml. Reference section 5.2.3 in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md.

title: Add Output-returning function variant generation
description: The current gen_function.go generates async functions that return Future<Result>. Consider also generating an invoke-style variant that returns Output<Result> for cases where the function result needs to be used as an input to other resources without await. This follows the pattern used in other Pulumi SDKs where both getXxxAsync() and getXxx() (or getXxxOutput()) variants are provided.

title: Set up pub.dev publishing for core SDK
description: Prepare the pulumi package for pub.dev publishing. Complete pubspec.yaml with all metadata (repository, homepage, description). Add LICENSE (Apache 2.0), README.md, CHANGELOG.md, example/. Run dart pub publish --dry-run to verify. Set up verified publisher account. Create CI/CD automation for publishing releases.

title: Implement GenerateProject for Dart templates
description: GenerateProject is currently stubbed out. Need to implement project generation from Dart templates including Pulumi.yaml, pubspec.yaml, and main.dart. See the templates/ directory structure in the implementation plan.

title: Implement Pulumi.run() entry point
description: Implement the Pulumi.run() static method in sdk/dart/lib/src/pulumi.dart. This is the main entry point for user programs. Must: accept a callback function with PulumiContext, manage the context lifecycle, handle stack exports via ctx.export(), wait for all resource registrations to complete, handle errors and report them to the engine.

title: Implement Resource base class with async registration
description: Implement the Resource base class as specified in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md Section 4.3.1. Use scheduleMicrotask + Completer pattern for async initialization since Dart constructors cannot be async. Include: urn as late Output<String>, _registered Completer for completion signaling, _scheduleRegistration() method, abstract inputs getter, _register() method that calls ResourceMonitor.registerResource, abstract _processOutputs() method, and _collectDependencies() for gathering URNs from Output dependencies.

title: Fix code style issues in generated SDKs
description:
Generated resource files have info-level lint warnings:
1. Dangling library doc comments - Add 'library' directive after library comments
2. Constructor ordering - Constructors should be before non-constructor declarations
3. Various null-aware operator warnings

These don't block functionality but should be fixed for clean SDK generation.

title: Implement PCL to Dart conversion (GenerateProgram)
description: Implement the GenerateProgram function in cmd/pulumi-language-dart/codegen.go. This function converts PCL (Pulumi Configuration Language) files to Dart code, enabling 'pulumi convert' to work with Dart as a target language. Currently returns 'not yet implemented' error. Should use PCL binding similar to how GenerateProject works for other languages.

title: Fix code style issues in generated Dart code
description:
The code generator produces Dart code with style issues flagged by dart analyze:
- Dangling library doc comments (need to add 'library' directive after doc comment)
- Constructor declarations not before other members (sort_constructors_first lint)
- protobuf dependency should be added to generated pubspec.yaml

These are info-level lints that don't affect correctness but should be fixed for clean generated code.

title: Implement proper serialization for complex types in function args
description: The current function args map builder uses direct values (e.g., 'field': objectValue) which won't work correctly for complex types like nested objects. Object types need to call toPropertyMap() before being added to the args map. Arrays of objects need to be mapped to property maps. This mirrors the serialization pattern needed in resource inputs.

title: Update generated pubspec.yaml to use correct protobuf version
description: The code generator outputs protobuf: ^3.1.0 but the core pulumi SDK uses protobuf: ^6.0.0. The generator should be updated to use the compatible version. Also consider using path dependency for local development vs pub.dev version for published packages.

title: Update go.mod to use real repository URL instead of example
description: The go.mod files in cmd/pulumi-language-dart and pkg/codegen/dart still use 'github.com/example/pulumi-dart' instead of the actual repository URL 'github.com/bdero/pulumi-dart'. This should be updated before publishing releases.

title: Implement Dart code generator for provider SDKs
description: Implement the GeneratePackage function in cmd/pulumi-language-dart/codegen.go. This should parse Pulumi package schemas and generate Dart resource classes, function wrappers, type definitions, and pubspec.yaml. Refer to existing code generators (Python, TypeScript, Go) in the Pulumi repo for patterns. This is needed to generate SDKs like pulumi_aws, pulumi_gcp, etc.

title: Add integration tests for language host
description: Create integration tests that verify the language host works with actual Pulumi CLI operations. Should test Run, InstallDependencies, and GetRequiredPlugins with real Dart projects. Current test coverage is ~53% due to mocking limitations.

title: Add codegen tests for resource generation
description: Add comprehensive tests for resource generation in pkg/codegen/dart. Test cases should include: simple resources, resources with complex nested inputs, component resources, resources with deprecation messages, and resources with various property types (arrays, maps, enums).

title: Add serialization tests for nested Output/Input in collections
description: The serialization code handles Output and Input values embedded within lists and maps (line 223-228 in serialization.dart), but test coverage for these nested cases could be improved. Add tests for: 1) List containing Output values, 2) Map with Output values, 3) Deeply nested structures mixing primitives, Outputs, and Inputs.

title: Regenerate pulumi_gcp SDK to verify type collision fix
description: The type name collision fix (qualified class names with module prefix) was implemented. Regenerate the pulumi_gcp SDK to verify the ~687 ambiguous_export errors are resolved.

title: Generate fromPropertyMap method for ObjectTypes
description: The resource code generator calls ClassName.fromPropertyMap() on nested ObjectTypes, but the type generator doesn't generate this factory constructor. Need to add fromPropertyMap factory constructor generation to gen_type.go. This is needed for deserialization of nested types from protobuf Struct fields.

title: Integrate Resource with actual ResourceMonitor gRPC client
description: Currently Resource._register() has mock implementation. Once TH-34a7if (ResourceMonitor gRPC client) and TH-0oziai (Runtime singleton) are complete, update Resource._register() to make actual gRPC calls to ResourceMonitor.registerResource and properly handle the response.

title: Create Pulumi project templates for Dart
description: Create project templates in templates/ directory: dart/ (basic template), aws-dart/ (AWS starter), kubernetes-dart/ (K8s starter). Each template needs: Pulumi.yaml.template, pubspec.yaml.template, bin/main.dart.template. Register templates so 'pulumi new dart' and 'pulumi new aws-dart' work.

title: Add pluginDownloadURL to generated provider SDKs
description: The generated Dart SDKs for providers should include pluginDownloadURL configuration so that users can automatically install the pulumi-language-dart plugin. This should be set to 'github://api.github.com/bdero/pulumi-dart' in the codegen output.

title: Add invokeOutput helper for Output-returning invokes
description: Add an invokeOutput function that returns Output<T> directly (sugar for invoke().apply()). This is a common pattern in generated SDKs where the invoke result is immediately transformed.

title: Integrate union type sealed class generation into main generator
description: The generateUnionType function in gen_union.go generates Dart sealed classes for complex union types, but it's not yet integrated into the main code generator workflow. Need to: 1) Detect complex union types in properties during type/resource/function generation, 2) Track unique union types needed across the package, 3) Generate union type files in lib/src/unions/ directory, 4) Add proper imports for generated union types.

title: Pass configSecretKeys from executor to Dart SDK
description: The Go executor (language.go) receives configSecretKeys in the RunRequest, but this list is not currently passed to the Dart program. Add support for passing secret key information via an environment variable (e.g., PULUMI_CONFIG_SECRET_KEYS) so the Config class can automatically detect which values are secrets without requiring users to explicitly use getSecret/requireSecret.

title: Add Output.fromPropertyValue deserialization helper to Dart SDK
description: The generated resource code uses Output.fromPropertyValue<T> for deserializing property values. This helper method needs to be added to the Output class in sdk/dart/lib/src/output.dart. It should handle type coercion, null values, and nested complex types.

title: Implement Dart function generation
description: Implement function generation in pkg/codegen/dart/gen_function.go. Must: generate async function wrappers that call Invoke, generate function argument types, generate function result types, handle optional parameters, generate dartdoc from schema descriptions. Functions are used for data source lookups (e.g., getAvailabilityZone).

title: Generate pulumi_gcp provider SDK
description: Generate the Google Cloud Platform provider SDK. This is the second provider to target after pulumi_random, prioritized over AWS. GCP is a large provider that will validate the generator handles complex schemas with many resources and nested types.

title: Document cross-stack reference usage in README
description: Add documentation for using StackReference in the README.md. Include: 1) Basic usage example, 2) Stack name format (org/project/stack), 3) Accessing individual outputs vs all outputs, 4) Secret output handling, 5) Error handling for missing outputs. Reference the TypeScript and Python SDK documentation for consistency.

title: Add ProviderResource class for explicit provider instantiation
description: Implement ProviderResource class that extends CustomResource. This allows users to explicitly instantiate providers with specific configurations (e.g., aws.Provider with a specific region). The ProviderResource should generate a provider reference string that can be passed to ResourceOptions.provider field. Reference: https://www.pulumi.com/docs/concepts/resources/providers/

title: Add ComponentResource integration test
description: Create an integration test that verifies ComponentResource registration and registerOutputs work correctly end-to-end. Should test parent-child relationships and output aggregation.

title: Implement Input<T> sealed class hierarchy
description: Implement the Input<T> sealed class hierarchy as specified in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md Section 4.3.1. Create InputValue<T>, InputOutput<T>, and InputFuture<T> final classes. Each must implement toOutput() method. Add InputExtension for implicit conversion from raw values. This enables type-safe union handling for resource inputs using Dart 3 pattern matching.

title: Export language.proto types from SDK
description: The language.proto Dart types have been generated but are not yet exported from the SDK's public API. Add exports for LanguageRuntimeServiceBase and related types so they can be used by downstream code, including the language host implementation.

title: Fix ambiguous exports in pulumi_gcp due to name collisions
description: The pulumi_gcp provider has ambiguous export errors where multiple types with the same name (e.g., AppProfileDataBoostIsolationReadOnly) are exported from different modules (bigquery vs bigtable). The code generator needs to be updated to either: 1) Use fully qualified names or prefixes for types to avoid collisions, 2) Only export types from one module and use imports for others, or 3) Generate unique class names that include the module namespace. Affects pulumi_gcp.dart exports.

title: Add aliases support to ResourceOptions
description: Add support for resource aliases in ResourceOptions as specified in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md. This enables renaming or moving resources without causing recreation. Implement: aliases property as List<String>, pass aliases through to RegisterResourceRequest, support both URN-style and typed aliases.

title: Implement GenerateProgram for PCL to Dart conversion
description:
The GenerateProgram function in codegen.go is currently stubbed out. This function should convert Pulumi Configuration Language (PCL) programs to Dart code.

This enables:
- pulumi convert to convert programs to Dart
- pulumi import to generate Dart code for existing resources

Refer to existing code generators (TypeScript, Python, Go) in the Pulumi repo for patterns.

title: Implement Config class for stack configuration
description: Implement the Config class in sdk/dart/lib/src/config.dart. This class should provide access to stack configuration values set via 'pulumi config set'. Must support: getting required values (throw if missing), getting optional values (return null), getting values with defaults, type coercion (string, int, bool, json), secret handling.

title: Add integration test for StackReference with real Pulumi engine
description: Create an integration test that verifies StackReference works correctly when connected to a real Pulumi engine. This should test: 1) Referencing an actual stack and retrieving outputs, 2) Secret output handling, 3) Error handling for non-existent stacks. Requires setting up test fixtures with known stack outputs.

title: Implement Dart type generation from Pulumi schema
description: Implement the core type generation logic in pkg/codegen/dart. This includes: proper handling of complex nested types, union type generation using sealed classes, proper import path resolution across generated modules, and comprehensive test coverage for type generation edge cases.

title: Add query mode support to Run method
description: The Run method receives a QueryMode field in RunRequest but does not currently handle it. Query mode is used for pulumi query commands and should set appropriate environment variables or modify execution behavior.

title: Support custom plugin server URLs in pubspec.yaml
description: Currently GetRequiredPlugins always sets Server to empty string (using default plugin source). Add support for specifying custom plugin download URLs in pubspec.yaml, similar to how Python SDK supports custom pip package indexes. Could use a metadata field like 'pulumi_plugin_server' or parse hosted dependencies.

title: Add import ID support for existing resources
description: Add support for importing existing cloud resources into Pulumi state. Implement CustomResourceOptions with importId property that passes to RegisterResourceRequest.importId. This allows 'pulumi import' to work with Dart resources.

title: Implement InstallDependencies (dart pub get)
description: Implement InstallDependencies in the language host. Must: run 'dart pub get' in the project directory, capture output, handle errors, return success/failure status. Should also verify Dart SDK is installed and meets minimum version requirements (3.0.0+).

title: Add asset/archive serialization support
description: Extend PropertySerializer to handle asset and archive types for serialization. Currently only deserialization of FileAsset, StringAsset, RemoteAsset, FileArchive, and RemoteArchive is supported. Need to add corresponding serialization with proper Pulumi signatures. This enables sending file contents and archives to providers.

title: Implement Dart resource class generation
description: Implement resource generation in pkg/codegen/dart/gen_resource.go. Must: generate resource classes extending CustomResource/ComponentResource, generate *Args classes for resource inputs with Input<T> types, generate output property declarations as Output<T>, handle resource options, generate dartdoc comments from schema descriptions, follow the patterns shown in PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md Section 4.4.1.

title: Wire Resource class to use ResourceMonitor
description: Update the Resource base class (sdk/dart/lib/src/resource.dart) to use the real ResourceMonitor gRPC client instead of the mock implementation. This includes: removing mock URN generation, calling monitor.registerResource() with serialized inputs, processing the RegisterResourceResponse to populate URN and outputs. Depends on the Runtime singleton being implemented to provide access to the monitor.

title: Add PropertyDeserializer helper for complex type deserialization
description: The code generator references PropertyDeserializer.deserializeStruct() for complex nested types (ObjectType), but this class doesn't exist. This causes errors in providers with nested types (like GCP). Need to either add PropertyDeserializer to the core pulumi package or inline the deserialization logic in the generated code. Affects: gen_resource.go lines 301, 303, 334, 356.

title: Implement Dart type generation from Pulumi schema
description: Implement type generation in pkg/codegen/dart/gen_type.go. Must: map Pulumi primitives to Dart types (string->String, integer->int, number->double, boolean->bool), generate complex object types as Dart classes, generate enum types with string values, handle union types using sealed classes, generate List<T> and Map<String, T> types.

title: Fix stack outputs not being registered properly
description:
During E2E testing, discovered that stack outputs (ctx.export) are not being saved to the Pulumi state. The SDK calls RegisterResourceOutputs with a stack URN, but the stack resource itself is never registered. This means the outputs have nowhere to be stored.

The fix likely requires:
1. Register a pulumi:pulumi:Stack component resource at the start of Pulumi.run()
2. Use the URN returned from that registration when calling RegisterResourceOutputs
3. Or get the stack URN from the engine via GetRootResource and use that

Reference: Other Pulumi SDKs register a Stack component resource first before registering outputs on it.

title: Improve function result deserialization for complex types
description: The current fromPropertyMap factory in function results uses simple as casts (e.g., properties['field'] as MyType) which won't work for complex nested types like arrays of objects, maps of objects, or enum types. Need to implement proper deserialization similar to how processOutputs handles complex types in resources - using proper type conversions like List.map for arrays and Map.fromEntries for maps.

title: Add tests for gen_resource.go resource generation
description: Add comprehensive unit tests for generateResource function in gen_resource.go to cover: resource class generation, Args class generation, output property declarations, component vs custom resource distinction, deprecation handling, import collection. Target is at least 80% coverage for this file.

title: Add library directive to generated Dart files
description: Generated Dart files have dangling library doc comments. Add a 'library' directive after the file header comment to fix the 'dangling_library_doc_comments' lint warnings.

title: Generate pulumi_random provider SDK
description: Generate the first provider SDK using the Dart code generator. pulumi_random is the simplest provider (~5 resources) and ideal for proving out the generator. Should produce a complete, publishable Dart package with all resource types, function invokes, and proper documentation.

title: Implement Asset and Archive types in Dart SDK
Add tests for AssetArchive (archive containing assets)
description: The serialization.dart file has logic for deserializing asset archives (archives containing assets), but there are no tests covering this functionality. Add tests for nested asset/archive structures like archives containing file assets, string assets, and remote assets.

title: Add StackReference support for cross-stack output references
description: The SDK currently has docstrings mentioning StackReference but there's no actual implementation. Implement a StackReference class that allows reading stack outputs from other stacks. This enables cross-stack dependencies. Reference: Other Pulumi SDKs have StackReference that reads outputs from previously deployed stacks.

title: Add negative test cases for error handling
description: Add tests that verify proper error handling in edge cases: 1) PropertyDeserializer handling malformed protobuf structures, 2) Output operations when underlying futures throw exceptions, 3) Input.resolve with invalid input types. These will ensure robustness of the SDK primitives.

title: Update integration tests to use generated provider SDKs
description: Once provider SDKs are generated (pulumi_random), update tests/integration/testdata/basic_random to use the generated pulumi_random package instead of manually defining the RandomString resource inline. This will validate that the generated code works correctly end-to-end.

title: Implement GeneratePackage for Dart SDK codegen
description: GeneratePackage is currently stubbed out. Need to implement Dart code generation from Pulumi schema to generate provider SDKs (resource classes, function wrappers, type definitions). This is a major implementation task in pkg/codegen/dart/.

title: Test code generator with real provider schemas
description:
The code generator has been tested with a minimal random-like schema. It should be tested with actual Pulumi provider schemas (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes) to ensure it handles:
- Large numbers of resources and types
- Complex nested types
- All edge cases in real provider schemas

This will likely reveal additional edge cases that need handling.

title: Document proto regeneration process
description: Create documentation for how to regenerate proto files when Pulumi protos are updated. Include version compatibility notes for protoc_plugin and protobuf packages.

title: Implement StackReference for cross-stack references
description: Implement StackReference class in sdk/dart/lib/src/stack.dart. Must: allow referencing outputs from other stacks, support getOutput(key) to retrieve stack outputs, handle the async nature of cross-stack lookups. This enables multi-stack architectures where one stack references another's outputs.

title: Implement Runtime singleton with gRPC client management
description: Implement the Runtime singleton in sdk/dart/lib/src/runtime/runtime.dart. The Runtime class manages the connection to the Pulumi engine, providing: initialization from CLI args (--monitor, --engine addresses), access to ResourceMonitor and Engine clients, shutdown coordination. It should be a singleton that is initialized once at program start. See PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md Section 4.2.1 for reference.

title: Implement Invoke helper for provider functions
description: Implement the Invoke class/methods in sdk/dart/lib/src/invoke.dart. Must: call ResourceMonitor.Invoke with function token and args, handle InvokeOptions, return deserialized result. This is used by generated function wrappers to call provider data sources (e.g., aws.getAvailabilityZone).

title: Test with real Pulumi CLI and pulumi-random provider
description: Once the language host is installable via pulumi plugin install, create a test that runs actual pulumi preview and pulumi up commands with the pulumi-random provider. This is true end-to-end testing that verifies the full Pulumi workflow.

title: Add CI workflow for pub.dev publishing on release
description: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the SDK to pub.dev when a new release is created. Should run dart pub publish --force after successful CI checks on tagged releases. Requires setting up pub.dev credentials as GitHub secrets.

title: Implement Run method with Dart executor spawning
description: Implement the Run method in the language host that spawns the Dart executor. Must: detect execution mode from runtime.options (run/aot/binary), spawn 'dart run' or the appropriate executor, pass --monitor and --engine gRPC addresses as CLI args, capture stdout/stderr, handle exit codes, report errors back to engine.

title: Fix fromPropertyMap/toPropertyMap in function generator
description: The generateFunctionArgs and generateFunctionResult functions in gen_function.go have the same bug that was fixed in gen_type.go (TH-ec7ei9). They don't properly serialize/deserialize nested ObjectTypes - they just cast values directly instead of calling fromPropertyMap/toPropertyMap recursively. Should reuse the generatePropertyMapExtraction and generateToPropertyMapValue helpers from gen_type.go.

title: Implement GenerateProject for Dart project templates
description:
The GenerateProject function in codegen.go is currently stubbed out. This function should create new Dart Pulumi projects from templates.

This enables:
- pulumi new dart to create new Dart projects
- Template customization with project name, etc.

Need to:
1. Create project template files
2. Implement template variable substitution
3. Register templates with Pulumi

title: Wire codegen into pulumi package gen-sdk
description: Integrate Dart codegen with 'pulumi package gen-sdk --language dart'. Implement GeneratePackage in the language host to invoke the codegen. Test SDK generation for pulumi-random (simple) and pulumi-aws (complex). Verify generated code compiles and works correctly.

title: Update example repository URLs in documentation
description: The PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md file still contains 'https://github.com/example/pulumi-dart' as an example repository URL. This should be updated to reflect the real repository URL 'https://github.com/bdero/pulumi-dart' for consistency throughout the codebase.

title: Add logging utilities to PulumiContext
description: Add logging helper methods to PulumiContext that delegate to EngineService when available. Methods should include: debug(), info(), warning(), error(). Should fall back to print() when Engine is not connected. This enables users to log messages that appear in the Pulumi CLI output.

title: Handle type name collisions in code generator
description: Large providers like GCP have types with identical names in different modules (e.g., AppProfileDataBoostIsolationReadOnly exists in both bigquery and bigtable). When these are exported from the main library file, Dart produces ambiguous_export errors. Solution: qualify type names with module prefix (e.g., BigqueryAppProfileDataBoostIsolationReadOnly) or use 'show'/'hide' in exports to avoid collisions. ~687 ambiguous export errors in GCP SDK.

title: Add debug attachment support for Dart programs
description: The Run method should support the AttachDebugger option from RunRequest, similar to the Go language host. This would allow developers to debug their Pulumi Dart programs using Dart DevTools or IDE debuggers.

title: Create Pulumi template files for template registry
description: Create the templates/dart/ directory with Pulumi template files (Pulumi.yaml.template, pubspec.yaml.template, bin/main.dart.template) that can be registered with the Pulumi template registry. This would enable 'pulumi new dart' to use the official template system rather than relying solely on GenerateProject. Reference the template format used in https://github.com/pulumi/templates

title: Implement Config class for stack configuration
description: Implement the Config class in sdk/dart/lib/src/config.dart. Must support: require(key) - get required config value or throw, get(key) - get optional config value, requireSecret(key)/getSecret(key) - for secret values, requireInt/requireBool/etc for typed access. Config values come from the Pulumi stack configuration (Pulumi.<stack>.yaml).

title: Generate Dart code from Pulumi proto files
description: Set up proto compilation using protoc with dart_out=grpc: option. Generate Dart code from resource.proto, provider.proto, engine.proto, plugin.proto, alias.proto, callback.proto. Place generated code in sdk/dart/lib/src/proto/. Verify gRPC client functionality with a simple test. This is the foundation that all other SDK work depends on.

title: Remove unnecessary casts in generated property deserialization code
description: The code generator generates unnecessary casts like 'PropertyDeserializer.deserializeStruct(...) as Map<String, dynamic>' but deserializeStruct already returns Map<String, dynamic>. Update gen_resource.go lines 301, 303, 334, 356 to remove the redundant cast. This triggers Dart analyzer warnings.

title: Implement property serialization/deserialization
description: Implement PropertySerializer in sdk/dart/lib/src/runtime/serialization.dart. Must handle: null, bool, int, double, String, List, Map, and Output values. Serialize Dart values to protobuf Struct/Value format. Deserialize protobuf Struct back to Dart types. Handle special Output serialization with dependency signatures. This is critical for communicating with the Pulumi engine.

title: Create API reference documentation with dartdoc
description: Set up dartdoc generation for the SDK. Add comprehensive dartdoc comments to all public APIs. Generate and host API reference documentation. Create getting started guide with examples. Document the Resource lifecycle, Output/Input patterns, and Config usage.

title: Implement ResourceOptions and CustomResourceOptions
description: Implement ResourceOptions and CustomResourceOptions in sdk/dart/lib/src/options.dart. ResourceOptions: parent (Resource?), dependsOn (List<Resource>?), protect (bool?), provider, aliases, etc. CustomResourceOptions extends ResourceOptions with: id for importing existing resources, deleteBeforeReplace, additionalSecretOutputs, etc.

title: Investigate and fix non-zero exit code from language host
description:
During E2E testing on Windows, the pulumi CLI returns exit code 127 (-1) even when operations complete successfully. The log shows:

langhost[dart].Run(...) failed: err=grpc: the client connection is closing

This appears to be a race condition where Pulumi kills the language plugin before the Run RPC completes. The operations succeed (resources are created/deleted) but the exit code is incorrect.

Investigation needed:
1. Check if this is Windows-specific or affects all platforms
2. Look at how other language hosts handle shutdown
3. May need to add graceful shutdown handling in the language host

title: Set up provider packages structure in monorepo
description: Create the providers/ directory structure for generated provider SDKs. Each provider should be a separate publishable Dart package. Structure: providers/pulumi_random/, providers/pulumi_gcp/, etc. Each with its own pubspec.yaml that depends on the core pulumi package.

title: Wire Dart codegen package into language host
description: Connect the pkg/codegen/dart package to the language host in cmd/pulumi-language-dart/codegen.go. Update the GeneratePackage function to use the new codegen package instead of returning 'not implemented'. This will enable 'pulumi package gen-sdk --language dart' to work.

title: Add Pulumi.yaml template generation
description: Implement the GenerateProject function in cmd/pulumi-language-dart/codegen.go. This should generate a new Dart Pulumi project from templates including: Pulumi.yaml with runtime: dart, pubspec.yaml with pulumi dependency, bin/main.dart with Pulumi.run() entry point. This enables 'pulumi new dart' to work.

title: Add screenshots to pubspec.yaml for pub.dev
description: Add screenshots to pubspec.yaml to improve package presentation on pub.dev. Should include a screenshot demonstrating the SDK in action, ideally showing code editor with Pulumi Dart code and pulumi up output.

title: Test SDK generation with pulumi-aws schema
description: Download the actual pulumi-aws schema and test SDK generation with a complex provider. Verify the generated code handles AWS's many resources, types, and functions correctly. Check for any codegen edge cases.

title: Add AOT snapshot cleanup after execution
description: In AOT execution mode, the buildAotCommand function creates a snapshot file in .dart_tool/pulumi_aot.aot. This should be cleaned up after execution to avoid stale artifacts. Consider adding a defer cleanup or using a temp file pattern.

title: Implement Invoke function for provider function calls
description: Implement the Invoke helper function/class for calling provider functions (data sources). Provider functions return data without creating resources. Needs: InvokeOptions class, integration with ResourceMonitor.invoke(), proper serialization/deserialization of args and results. Example: aws.getAvailabilityZones(). See PULUMI_DART_PLAN_V2.md section 4.3.2 and the invoke.dart placeholder.

title: Fix constructor ordering lint in generated resources
description: Generated resource classes have constructors after field declarations, triggering 'sort_constructors_first' lint warnings. Move constructor declarations before non-constructor members.

title: Create end-to-end integration test setup
description: Set up integration testing infrastructure. Create test project structure that can run actual Pulumi programs. Test resource registration flow end-to-end with the language host and SDK working together. Test with pulumi-random provider (simplest provider). Verify pulumi preview and pulumi up work correctly.

title: Add Output dependency tracking integration test
description: Create an integration test that verifies Output dependencies are correctly tracked across resources. Test that resources with Output<T> inputs have their dependencies properly serialized and sent to the ResourceMonitor.

title: Add offline mode support for InstallDependencies
description: Consider adding --offline flag support to dart pub get for environments without network access. This would be useful for CI/CD environments with cached dependencies.

title: Add custom timeouts support to ResourceOptions
description: Add support for custom create/update/delete timeouts in CustomResourceOptions. Map to RegisterResourceRequest.customTimeouts. This allows users to specify how long Pulumi should wait for long-running operations.

title: Add PropertyDeserializer import to generated resource code
description: The generated resource code uses PropertyDeserializer for complex type deserialization (objects, enums) but this is imported from the runtime/serialization.dart module. Verify this import is properly handled and add it if missing. The current code relies on this being available via the main pulumi.dart export.

title: Wire invoke helper into generated function wrappers
description: Update the Dart code generator to generate function wrappers that use the invoke() helper from the SDK. Currently gen_function.go generates functions, but they may need to be updated to use the new invoke API for proper serialization/deserialization and error handling.

title: Update typeToDart() to return generated union type names
description: Currently typeToDart() in utilities.go returns 'Object' for complex unions. After union types are generated in lib/src/unions/, the typeToDart() function should be updated to return the actual generated union type name (e.g., 'StringOrInt') instead of 'Object'. This will require passing context about available union types or using a two-pass generation approach.

title: Add union type imports in resources/functions/types
description: When a resource, function, or type property uses a complex union type, the generated Dart file should import the union type from '../unions/<union_name>.dart'. Currently the import collection in collectTypeImportsFromType() needs to be updated to detect complex unions and add the appropriate import path.

title: Implement LanguageRuntime gRPC server
description: Implement the LanguageRuntime gRPC server in cmd/pulumi-language-dart/language.go. Must implement all methods from language.proto: GetPluginInfo, GetRequiredPlugins, Run, InstallDependencies, About, GetProgramDependencies, GeneratePackage, GenerateProject, Pack, RuntimeOptionsPrompts. Initial implementation can stub some methods.

title: Create Dart code generator package structure
description: Create Go package at pkg/codegen/dart/. Set up module structure with: gen.go (main generator), gen_resource.go, gen_type.go, gen_function.go, gen_enum.go, utilities.go (Dart naming conventions). Use existing pkg/codegen/schema for schema parsing. Follow patterns from existing codegen packages (python, nodejs, java).

content:
Fixed in commit f15258d. The type name collision fix was implemented:
1. Resources use tokenToQualifiedClassName (module prefix)
2. Types use tokenToQualifiedTypeClassName (adds 'Type' suffix for types that could collide)
3. Functions use module-prefixed names
4. Added reserved property names to avoid base class member conflicts

The pulumi_gcp SDK now compiles with 0 errors.
Already complete - the language host is wired to the codegen package. Successfully generating pulumi_gcp SDK with 'pulumi package gen-sdk --language dart'.

Fixed type collisions successfully. After implementing several fixes:

1. Resources now use tokenToQualifiedClassName (module prefix)
2. Types use tokenToQualifiedTypeClassName which adds 'Type' suffix for:
   - Types with PascalCase in submodule path (detected via isTypeToken)
   - Types ending with 'Result' (to avoid collision with function result classes)
3. Functions use module-prefixed names to avoid collisions (e.g., alloydbGetInstance)
4. Added reserved property names: type, options, id, override, properties
5. Added objectReservedNames for Args classes (runtimeType, hashCode, etc.)

Result: pulumi_gcp SDK now compiles with 0 errors (only warnings/info for style).
Already implemented - gen_enum.go line 96 generates the fromValue factory constructor.
Closed as duplicate: completed in TH-nkzpfw

Fixed by using the generatePropertyMapExtraction and generateToPropertyMapValue helpers from gen_type.go in the function generator's fromPropertyMap and toPropertyMap methods. Now nested ObjectTypes are properly serialized/deserialized.
This work is already complete. The type generation is implemented in gen_type.go with proper handling for nested types, import path resolution, and test coverage.

The code generator currently maps Asset and Archive types to Object because these types haven't been implemented in the Dart SDK yet. This ticket is to implement proper Asset and Archive classes that match the behavior of other Pulumi SDKs.
Not needed - the generated code uses Output.of() with inline deserialization instead of a fromPropertyValue helper. The current approach works well with the PropertyDeserializer helper.
Fixed - updated gen.go to use protobuf: ^6.0.0 instead of ^3.1.0
